about: Store and restaurant destination names Kokoro's Misaki dictionary lacks (BI-093, loop B107). ForSpeech leaves names alone except Buc-ee's (one word, Buckees) and HEB/H-E-B (capitals only: letters H E B); the 'words' list must each be in the app's pronunciation dictionary with phonemes (Kroger KROH-gur, Meijer MY-ur, Publix PUB-liks, Wegmans WEG-munz, Lidl LEE-dul, Aldi AHL-dee, Costco KOST-koh, Qdoba kyoo-DOH-buh, Whataburger WUT-uh-bur-gur, Panera puh-NAIR-uh, Popeyes POP-yz, Zaxby ZAKS-bee, Culver KUL-vur, Bojangles boh-JANG-gulz, Bruegger BROO-gur, Hardee HAR-dee, Applebee AP-ul-bee, Krispy KRIS-pee, Dunkin DUN-kin, Arby AR-bee, Pei PAY, Wawa WAH-wah, Sheetz SHEETS, Buckees BUK-eez, Valero vuh-LAIR-oh, Exxon EK-sahn, RaceTrac RAYS-trak, Ulta UL-tuh, Sephora suh-FOR-uh). Shared with BookLyre (CROSS). Keys are letters only: the tokenizer splits "Arby's" into the name and 's.
